body:
Add the `Post Editor` dockable panel in `crates/ui` with the core editing, preview, error, and file workflows.

**Layout design implemented:** Design A (docked beside open panels) and Design B core (Solo mode covering script text, sample selection, G-code preview, and error line). See the layout sketches on #2050. Note: Snippet library and Declared options panes join in follow-up slices.

## Scope

1. Add `Tab::PostEditor` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs`) and `Panel::PostEditor` (`crates/ui/src/state.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/mod.rs`), closeable and floatable (`closeable == true`), closed by default. Open it from `View -> Panels... -> Post Editor` and from a new button in Setup -> Post (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs`).
2. Add an `Expand / Solo` toggle button in the Post Editor bar to fill the central workspace while other panes collapse or hide, keeping `layout::closeable(&Tab::Viewport) == false` intact (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/layout.rs`). Add `Restore Layout` to return to the previous dock.
3. Build the JS editor over `egui::TextEdit::multiline(...).code_editor()` with `desired_width(f32::INFINITY)` inside a 2D `ScrollArea`, a cached `LayoutJob` JS syntax highlighter, a synchronized 1:1 line-number gutter marking error lines, and an inline Find bar (`Ctrl+F`).
4. Fix `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs` (`shortcuts`) so `Ctrl+Z` and `Ctrl+Y` respect `!typing` when a text field owns focus. Text edits use `TextEditUndoer` and never push CAD undo commands.
5. Add toolbar controls for `New Blank`, `Open`, `Save`, `Save As` (prompting in `<user_posts>` like `MachineFileEditor`), `Sample selection` dropdown, debounced preview (~250 ms) plus `Run`, and `Use Post` (`SelectPost` / `SetSetupPost` undoable command).
6. Show line-numbered G-code preview (reusing `crates/ui/src/egui_app/gcode_highlight.rs`) with a `"PREVIEW ONLY - use Post to write machine files"` banner. On script failure, retain the last good output dimmed with a stale notice and populate the `Error line` bar with a `Jump to line` button.
7. List discovered `.cps` files from `<user_posts>` inside Setup -> Post (`post_section`) and queue `CommandKind::SelectPostFile(path)` on selection.

## Done means

- Structural tests (`egui_kittest`) verify opening `Post Editor` from `View -> Panels...`, toggling `Expand / Solo` and restoring layout, and editing a script without pushing CAD undo commands.
- Structural tests verify that changing a script updates preview G-code on a sample, while a syntax error retains last good output and shows the error line.
- Structural tests verify saving a `.cps` file to a temp `CAMCRAFT_POSTS` folder and selecting it in Setup -> Post.

Part of #2050
